content.value_statement: SEO teams need clear reports and alerts without guessing from scattered metrics. This skill turns KPI data into source-tagged reports, thresholds, and next actions.
actual_capabilities: Creates SEO and GEO performance reports with period comparisons and source labels.
Builds executive, marketing, technical, or client-ready report sections.
Defines alert rules for rankings, traffic, technical health, backlinks, competitors, brand, and AI visibility.
Separates measured, user-provided, and estimated metrics in every deliverable.
Routes missing authority or content-quality inputs to the correct auditor skill.
Produces handoff summaries that can be saved after user confirmation.
limitations: It does not compute CORE-EEAT or CITE audit scores.
It needs analytics, Search Console, SEO tool, or user-provided data for measured results.
It does not replace raw keyword position tracking for detailed rank deltas.
Alert thresholds are estimates unless historical baselines are available.

use_cases.title: Prepare an executive SEO report
use_cases.description: Summarize traffic, rankings, authority, AI visibility, wins, risks, and next-period actions for leadership.

use_cases.title: Configure ranking and traffic alerts
use_cases.description: Create threshold rules, response priorities, delivery routing, cooldowns, and review steps for ongoing monitoring.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing report inputs
use_cases.description: Mark unavailable metrics as not evaluated and identify the next skill or data export needed for completion.

prompt_templates.title: Create a monthly report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO and GEO performance report for [domain] for [month]. Use last month as the comparison period and mark missing data clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Set basic alerts
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up SEO monitoring alerts for [domain]. Cover organic traffic, top keywords, indexation, backlinks, and AI citations.

prompt_templates.title: Build a stakeholder dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a stakeholder dashboard for [domain] using these exports: [sources]. Separate measured values, estimates, and follow-up questions.

prompt_templates.title: Tune anomaly thresholds
prompt_templates.prompt: Create alert thresholds for [domain] using these baseline metrics: [baselines]. Include priorities, cooldowns, escalation, and readback windows.

output_examples.input: Monthly report for example.com with traffic, rankings, and AI citation data.
output_examples.output: A concise dashboard with current and prior metrics, status labels, source notes, wins, watch areas, and prioritized actions.

output_examples.input: Alert setup for top keywords and organic traffic decline.
output_examples.output: An alert matrix with warning and critical thresholds, owners, channels, cooldowns, and first-response checks.

output_examples.input: Report request with no backlink or content-quality data.
output_examples.output: A report that marks those sections as not evaluated and recommends the correct follow-up skill or export.

best_practices: Provide the domain, report period, comparison period, audience, and available data sources.
Label each metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated before drawing conclusions.
Use historical baselines when creating alert thresholds to reduce false positives.
anti_patterns: Do not present estimated metrics as measured results.
Do not use this skill to compute CORE-EEAT or CITE scores.
Do not create alerts for categories the user did not request.

faq.question: Can this skill generate a full SEO report?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates source-tagged SEO and GEO performance reports with comparisons, status labels, and next actions.

faq.question: Can it set up ongoing alerts?
faq.answer: Yes. It defines alert rules, thresholds, priorities, routing, cooldowns, and response plans.

faq.question: Does it need connected tools?
faq.answer: No. It can work from user-provided exports, but connected tools improve measurement quality.

faq.question: Does it calculate audit scores?
faq.answer: No. It reports existing CORE-EEAT and CITE scores but sends scoring work to auditor skills.

faq.question: Can it track every keyword position change?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes ranking distribution and movers. Detailed raw rank tracking belongs to a rank tracker.

faq.question: How does it handle missing data?
faq.answer: It marks missing sections as not evaluated and identifies the next data source or skill needed.
